svg.text: The escape jump, from one spike in each jump motor neuron
NeuroMechFly in FlyGym: the TTM twitch extends the middle legs (red); the tibia extension is scripted; the wings don't move
fitted to flies' 0.48 m/s: TTM torque 86 µN·mm
Takeoff 5.8 ms after the GF spike

takes off at 0.2 m/s, 7.2 ms after
